# FunTech

> FunTech offers technology and coding camps for children across the UK, combining hands-on learning in programming, game design, 3D printing, and digital skills with flexible in-person and hybrid options.

FunTech specializes in STEM education for kids aged 7-16, featuring flagship programs in Scratch, Python, Unreal Engine, 3D modelling, and touch typing. The site provides both practical camp offerings and educational guides for parents and educators.

## Key Topics

- FunTech camps
- Scratch coding

## Core Camp Programs

- [Scratch Coding: Coding Courses for Kids & Tech Camps](https://funtech.co.uk/camp_types/view/scratch): FunTech Scratch visual coding camps for ages 7-10 and game creation
- [FunTech Flexi Unreal Game Design Camp: Ages 10–14 | Hybrid Learning Experience](https://funtech.co.uk/camp_types/view_flexi/unreal-game-design): FunTech hybrid Unreal Engine 4 game design camp for ages 10-14
- [3D Modelling for Kids: FunTech Summer Camp with 3D Printing](https://funtech.co.uk/camp_types/view/3d-modelling-printing): FunTech 3D modelling and printing summer camp using Blender software
- [FunTech In-Person Touch Typing Camp: Ages 7–16 | FunTyper Program](https://funtech.co.uk/camp_types/view/funtyper-touch-typing): FunTech FunTyper touch typing camp for ages 7-16 with interactive games

## Programming & Coding Guides

- [Python Programming for Kids: Advantages to Python Classes & Learning](https://funtech.co.uk/latest/python-programming-for-kids-advantages-to-python-classes-learning): Guide to Python programming for kids with FunTech classes and camps
- [How to Explain Object-Oriented Programming to Kids](https://funtech.co.uk/latest/explain-object-oriented-programming-to-kids): Guide to teaching OOP concepts to children in simple terms
- [The Best Car Games on Roblox (+ Learn to Make Your Own)](https://funtech.co.uk/latest/the-best-car-games-on-roblox-learn-to-make-your-own): Reviews of best Roblox car games with Lua game design tips

- [Is Roblox Suitable for My 12-Year-Old & What Can They Learn?](https://funtech.co.uk/latest/is-roblox-suitable-for-my-12-year-old-what-can-they-learn): Parental guide to Roblox safety, age ratings, and learning opportunities
- [Are Minecraft Servers Safe for My Child?](https://funtech.co.uk/latest/are-minecraft-servers-safe-for-kids): Parental guide to Minecraft server safety and online communication risks
